profile.title: Full-Stack Engineer
profile.introduction: I build production-grade SaaS and AI-powered products end-to-end, from Next.js interfaces and Fastify APIs to data pipelines, browser automation, computer vision, and Docker-based deployment.
profile.availability: Open to relevant full-stack, backend, and AI product engineering opportunities.

aboutParagraphs: I'm a Full-Stack Engineer with 4+ years of combined experience across production software development and embedded software quality assurance.

My work spans B2B SaaS, AI-powered products, computer vision, enterprise software, industrial monitoring, browser automation, billing systems, and production infrastructure. I enjoy taking products from operational requirements through system design, implementation, deployment, and production reliability.
My QA background shaped the systematic approach I bring to debugging, testing, traceability, and resilient software delivery.

satellyte.title: Full-Stack Engineer
satellyte.summary: Building an AI-powered B2B sales intelligence platform that transforms buying signals into scored leads.
highlights: Develop Next.js dashboards and Fastify/BullMQ services that process multiple buying-signal strategies.
Build multi-provider enrichment workflows for identifying and scoring decision-makers.
Implement browser automation with Playwright and Browserbase.
Develop public REST APIs with authentication, credit metering, and rate limiting.
Support production delivery with Docker, GitHub Actions, and GHCR.

nexio.title: Full-Stack Engineer
nexio.summary: Built and shipped three production systems spanning computer vision, AI recruitment, and industrial monitoring.
highlights: Developed a Python computer-vision service with FastAPI, YOLO, OpenCV, and TensorRT for three industrial camera feeds.
Built TypeScript APIs, role-based access control, event delivery, and a Next.js operator dashboard for three production lines.
Designed resilient delivery with idempotency keys, local buffering, and batch synchronization.
Developed a multi-tenant AI recruitment platform with AI CV screening, voice interviews, candidate pipelines, and Stripe billing.
Built an MQTT, Node-RED, TimescaleDB, Grafana, and Telegram monitoring pipeline.

delta.title: Full-Stack Developer
delta.summary: Developed an internal ERP platform connecting Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, and Production operations.
highlights: Built Next.js and React interfaces supported by REST APIs developed with Node.js and Express.js.
Designed operational data models using PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Implemented authentication, role-based access, search, filtering, pagination, exports, and cross-document workflows.
Translated internal operational workflows into practical product features.

sys.title: Software QA Engineer
sys.summary: Tested embedded automotive transmission control software under internal, automotive, and Japanese engineering standards.
highlights: Performed white-box testing on embedded transmission-control software written in C.
Achieved the required 100% test coverage across assigned software modules.
Developed unit tests with winAMS and debugged output discrepancies.
Built Excel-based verification tools and produced traceable test cases, coverage reports, and technical documentation.
